integrity: Exact proof of polar facet classification, circuit triangulation and Euclidean complementary-minor volumes; standard-library checker exhaustively reconstructed all facets and 42 determinants. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the five-dimensional unit-normalized eigenvalue-1 spectral realization of KG(5,2); does not generalize to arbitrary eigenpolytopes. The canonical vertex/facet counts are already published. Possible priority overlap with the unlocated 1986 Powers technical report remains.
title: A 42-simplex unimodular star triangulation and exact Euclidean volume of the Petersen eigenpolytope
